The '''Minister of Sith Intelligence''' or '''Sith Intelligence Minister''' was the leader of [[Sith Intelligence]], the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] intelligence organization. Sith Intelligence was formed by [[Darth Marr]] in the aftermath of the collapse of [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] and the [[Battle of Yavin 4 (Galactic War)|battle against Revan]], and [[Lana Beniko]] was given the position of minister. The position was analogous to the [[Minister of Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Minister of Intelligence]] in Imperial Intelligence.
